bullets.text: New Privacy Feature in iOS 26.3 - **Apple** introduces 'Limit Precise Location' to enhance user privacy.
Galaxy S26 Storage Upgrade Rumours - **Samsung** may offer free storage upgrades for pre-orders of the Galaxy S26 trio.
England Rugby Uses Apple Tech - **Apple** showcases how iPads and Macs assist England Rugby in live match analysis.
Ring Search Party Backlash - **Amazon's** new feature for finding lost dogs faces criticism for potential privacy concerns.
DJI Romo Robovac Security Issues - **DJI's** first robovac faces scrutiny after a major security vulnerability was exploited.
Airbnb Embraces AI for Support - **Airbnb** reports that a third of its customer support is now handled by AI.
India Partners with Alibaba - India's government collaborates with **Alibaba.com** to boost exports for startups.
Claude App Rises After Super Bowl - **Anthropic's** Claude app climbs to the top 10 following successful Super Bowl ads.
OpenAI Retires Controversial Models - **OpenAI** removes access to several legacy models, including the controversial GPT-4o.
